root_cause.text: The code unconditionally writes to `rates[ts->ts_final_idx + 1]` without checking whether `ts->ts_final_idx` is already at the last valid index (3 for an array of size 4), causing an out-of-bounds write when `ts->ts_final_idx` equals 3.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "'ts->ts_final_idx' can be 3 on 5212, so: info->status.rates[ts->ts_final_idx + 1].idx = -1; with the array defined as: struct ieee80211_tx_rate rates[IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES]; while the size is: #define IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES 4 is indeed bogus." The patch adds the guard `if (ts->ts_final_idx + 1 < IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES)` before the write.
